name: apartment-ultra
description: Apartment Ultra - 多租户公寓管理系统

scripts.dev:local: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "pnpm run dev:api" "pnpm run dev:web"
scripts.docker:build: cd docker && docker compose -f docker-compose.yaml build
scripts.docker:up: cd docker && docker compose -f docker-compose.yaml up -d
scripts.docker:down: cd docker && docker compose -f docker-compose.yaml down
scripts.docker:logs: cd docker && docker compose -f docker-compose.yaml logs -f
scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:api && pnpm run lint:web
scripts.type-check: pnpm run type-check:api && pnpm run type-check:web
scripts.test: pnpm run test:api && pnpm run test:web
